data.yaml: # All paths are relative to the project root unless absolute.
# Dataset roots — set these to your local paths
faceforensics_pp:   "data/raw/FaceForensics++"      # FF++ root — flat subfolders per method
# Synthetic test dataset (smoke-testing without real data)
fps_target: 8                 # sample at this effective fps
min_face_size: 80             # pixels, minimum bounding box side
margin: 0.4                   # fractional margin around face bbox
# rPPG — dedicated high-fps stream (MASTER_PLAN RISK 2 fix)
# NOTE: Standard frame_sampling.fps_target=8 violates Nyquist for bpm_max=210
#       rPPG branch requires >=25fps to avoid aliasing the cardiac signal.
fps_target: 25              # 25fps: Nyquist-safe margin for BPM up to 210
min_duration_sec: 8.0       # minimum clip length for reliable PPG extraction
availability_mask: true     # set false to disable rPPG branch entirely
eval.yaml: notes: "Cat B = voice-clone gap; Cat C+D = AV forgery"
notes: "FakeVideo-RealAudio — AV sync branch test (9,709 videos)"
notes: "Primary SRM blindspot — branch expected near-random here"
notes: "EVAL ONLY. Social-media content. Honest reality-check against in-domain AUC."
- per_domain_auroc         # ADD: not pooled — per dataset slice
- per_forgery_type_auroc   # ADD: composited / fully_synthetic / reenactment / audio_only
- per_skin_tone_eer        # ADD: fairness slice — uses FakeAVCeleb race labels
- coverage_vs_error_curve  # ADD: abstention vs accuracy tradeoff
# Bootstrap MUST group by video_id then by source_group_id (identity).
# AUROC must be computed at video level, NOT frame level.
group_by: "source_group_id"   # FIX: video-level grouping, not frame-level
aggregation: "video_mean"      # aggregate frame scores to video score first
branch_marginal_auroc: true      # compute delta AUROC per branch removal
skin_tone_eer: true              # fairness slice per branch
decision_threshold_pct: 1.0     # prune if delta AUROC < 1% at VRAM cost > 100MB
model.yaml: lora_rank: 8                       # only used if adaptation_mode == lora
output_dim: 384                    # CLS embedding dim passed to fusion
haar_levels: 1                     # 1-level Haar → LH, HL, HH subbands
fft_output_dim: 20                 # total FFT feature vector size
num_rois: 6                        # forehead, left cheek, right cheek, nose, chin, periorbital
output_dim: 16                     # rPPG feature vector (SNR, freq, coherence, etc.)
backbone: "dinov2_vits14"          # shared weights with semantic branch
face_quality_dim: 10               # blur, brightness, contrast, pose_yaw, pose_pitch,
video_quality_dim: 5               # fps, resolution_score, duration, audio_present, codec_quality
# DINO patch tokens: 256 patches (16x16) → upsample to 56×56
forensic_channels: 64             # from forensic CNN intermediate features
# Abstention thresholds (tuned on calibration set, NOT test set)
min_evidence_coverage: 0.3       # fraction of branches that are available
score_margin: 0.15               # |score - 0.5| must exceed this to decide
train.yaml: gradient_accumulation_steps: 2       # reduced: fewer backward passes per step
num_workers: 4                       # parallel DataLoader workers for GPU saturation
persistent_workers: true             # keep workers alive between epochs (faster)
spatial: 64                        # 64 for RTX 4060 8GB VRAM with 1-frame rep
temporal: 16                       # 16 for frozen spatial backbones (peak VRAM < 4.2GB)
fusion: 12                         # 12 keeps end-to-end full fusion safely within 6GB VRAM
av: 16                             # audio-visual branch batch size (5-frame lip windows)
max_val_samples: 5000                # 5,000 representative val clips for fast validation (~45s)
# Training epochs per phase (optimized for pre-initialized fine-tuning)
semantic_branch: 8                 # Phase 3: joint fine-tune from pre-trained Phase 1 & 2
temporal_branch: 10                # Phase 4: GRU on frozen spatial (was 25)
# Applied to BCEWithLogitsLoss to up-weight real (positive) class.
# WeightedRandomSampler: draw balanced batches (50% real, 50% fake)
# Strongly recommended given 1:18 imbalance from DF40 dominance.
samples_per_epoch: 40000           # 40k balanced samples/epoch (625 steps @ bs64 = ~3-4 mins/epoch)
# Alternatively: cap max fake samples per epoch to N×real count
# (use instead of balanced_sampling if you prefer no duplication)
max_fake_multiplier: 10            # cap fakes at 10× real count per epoch
use_max_fake_cap: false            # set true to use cap instead of weighted sampler
# Pairs: (real, fake) from same original source video
apply_to_fraction: 0.5             # fraction of batches adversarially perturbed
